sources.quote: or a change of coating or surface treatment.
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: HS-410 belongs only to PRG-X (Aurelia), so Aurelia is the only affected customer. Changing the coating from zinc-nickel (COAT-ZNNI) to zinc flake (COAT-ZNFLAKE) needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipment, plus 90 days' notice. CSR-AUR-R4 replaces R3, so the older R3 rule (notification only for a change within the same coating family) no longer applies. Nothing in force covers this change. DEV-121 only allows a thinner zinc-nickel layer, not a different coating.
